description: 廢水污染管制情形 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 桃園市政府環境保護局. 本資料係提供桃園市事業廢水、畜牧廢水、工業區專用污水下水道系統、公共及社區下水道系統污染管制情形，項目包含列管家數、查核家數、檢驗結果、行政處分件數、排放許可證核發情形、廢水處理專責單位或人員設置情形等。 統計數據每年更新1次。. Coverage: 桃園市政府環境保護局. The portal files it under the publisher 桃園市政府環境保護局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
